comment: Repository-owned authority for the Science lane. result_command in a trusted Issue must resolve here; raw shell text is never accepted.

cb16.noop@v1.description: Deterministic no-op science-lane entrypoint. Writes dummy RESULT.json and REPORT.md. Permitted only for dry runs.

cb16.smoke@v1.description: Bridge smoke-test entrypoint. Proves the Science lane can resolve an allowlisted command, execute it against an exact commit and collect deterministic artifacts. Writes DRY_RUN-labelled artifacts and must never be treated as a scientific result.
